subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Star Wars as Mythology
description: A fast breakdown of Star Wars as Mythology for builders.

hook.text: George Lucas studied Joseph Campbell before writing Star Wars. The film is the Hero's Journey retold.

buildup.text: Luke leaves home, meets a wise mentor, enters the underworld (Death Star), and returns transformed.

discovery.text: Darth Vader is Luke's Shadow—literally his father. Confronting him means confronting himself.

twist.text: Luke wins not by fighting but by refusing to fight. Compassion defeats the Emperor, not violence.

climax.text: Millions felt this story without knowing its mythic structure. That's how deep archetypes work.

punchline.text: Ancient myth. Space setting. Same truth.

quiz.question: Which mythologist influenced George Lucas when creating Star Wars?
